timing: POST-HOC relative to the completed VAR-1 family results, registered before executing this derived read. No prospective efficacy claim.
population: All 625 R01C construction utterances, identical aligned roster for all six sealed arms.

feedback.counts: sum official word and character TP/FP/FN
feedback.frozen_baseline: Compute F0 once from sealed PLAN pooled counts before constructing any variant utility, retain exactly the same F0 for PLANR contrasts. Persist F0 and source hash.
feedback.intent: Keep scenario_action_exact separate; it is not hidden in entity reward.

disagreement: Use shared canonical_answer / answers_disagree: scenario, action and sorted entity multiset, preserving strings. No ad hoc Unicode/case/whitespace transformations.
empty_gold: Require sealed slot_f1_exact_tp and slot_f1_exact_fn both zero. Require explicit fields, never infer missing as zero. Report false-positive counts/rates, format/fallback status and all-roster results together.

statistics.formal_metric: pooled official SLU-F1; report row-F1 and utility as distinct quantities

limits: Do not rescore, contact a model or read a new split.
Do not change old verdicts or sealed files.
Do not call a same-roster action winner a held-out learned policy.
Do not use a pooled metric half-width as a row-F1 detection guarantee.
No raw answer, transcript or gold text in repository/report.
